lines: d21: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Salvador Stein is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d21: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d21: 🕯️ Salvador Stein is dead — lockjaw. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d21: What Salvador kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d21: "Salvador's gone." Domingo looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Salvador." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d21: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Salvatore blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d21: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
d21: 📖 LEARNED: Patient Aim (Level 1). One shot. You don't take the shot unless it's the shot.
d21: 📖 LEARNED: Animal Behavior (Level 1). Most animals flee. Give them an escape route and they take it. Cornered animals fight.
d21: 📖 LEARNED: Wire Snares (Level 1). A loop of wire on a game trail. Simple, effective, ancient. Check at dawn.

d21: 📖 LEARNED: Come Get Some (Level 1). Make exactly the right noise and the blind thing comes to investigate. Goad a blinded monster within 3 tiles: it lurches toward the sound on its next move. Stand where you want it.
d21: 📖 LEARNED: Scarecrow (Level 1). You can stage a fake injury to lure monsters into traps. They fall for it. Every time.
d21: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d21: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Salvador Stein, 21 days. The mantle passes to Salvatore Adamczyk.
d21: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Salvatore Adamczyk, 34 — a hunting guide. Their hands know different work now: Beast-calm, Echo Location.
d21: The village's quarrel was with Salvador — and Salvador is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d21: At the grave, Domingo, Tamika, Nino and 3 more speak for Salvatore — "Salvador trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d21: The fire knew Salvatore before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
d46: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Salvatore Adamczyk is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d46: 🕯️ Salvatore is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.
d46: Emberhold watches to see if Haven holds without its dead — and presses the tribute down to 3,000 kcal/week while the chair is empty. They'll test the link. Count on it. (Trust -8.)

d46: Ashford watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.)

d46: 🕯️ Salvatore's funeral feast: 1,500 kcal from the pantry, and every shaken fire is fed — Emberhold. The village mourns together, and the links hold because the dead are honored, not because the grief was forgotten. (Trust mended — the -8 bought back with grain.)
d46: SALVATORE — GONE. 1 open question closed unanswered.
d46: 🕯️ Salvatore Adamczyk is dead — a stranger. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.

d46: 📖 LEARNED: Diplomatic Incident (Level 1). Trust builds 2x faster. You're TOO good though — once per week you can start a diplomatic incident: villagers argue, you pick the winner (+trust with them, -trust with the loser).
d46: 📖 LEARNED: Reading People (Level 1). Microexpressions leak truth. Watch the eyes, not the mouth. People tell you who they are.
d46: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Deep Read! You don't just read trust — you read intent. Know what they'll do next. (Your knowledge of Reading People amplifies your open_book.)
d46: 📖 LEARNED: Research & Records (Level 1). Find information fast: indexes, archives, and asking the right question.
d46: 📖 LEARNED: Wound Care (Level 1). Clean it, close it, cover it. Pressure stops bleeding. Clean water is better than dirty hands.
d46: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)
d46: 📖 LEARNED: Herbal Medicine (Level 1). Willow bark = aspirin. Yarrow stops bleeding. Plantain draws out infection. The pharmacy is outside.
d46: 📖 LEARNED: Stalk (Level 1). Move unseen. Close distance without being noticed.
